_comment: Linux needs no env.json. Inside a pixi environment (pixi.toml) nvcc, g++ and the CUDA toolkit are on PATH, so CMake's FindCUDAToolkit finds them with no path configured, the architecture comes from CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=native, and there is no Visual Studio or Windows SDK to point at. vcpkg comes from the VCPKG_ROOT environment variable. This file only documents that; it is not read by anything.
